plugin.name: Sticker Manager
plugin.short_description: Collect and send stickers: an official pack ships inside, you manage the library in the panel, she picks one and sends it herself
plugin.description: Give her a sticker collection of her own: a labeled official pack ships inside (190 stickers sorted into 22 categories, each with its own gag line; seeded into the 官方 zone on first launch and restorable from the panel, and labels are delivered when the pack is updated), and you can also create your own categories to collect into. In chat she picks one herself from the category and the context. png/jpg/gif/webp with animations preserved; every send is logged for cross-turn dedup and recent-favorite ranking.

panel.awareness.eagerness.help: Reserved preserves the 0.9.8 baseline; natural retains the observed 0.9.10 strategy. Eager prefers fitting images on most casual replies and may choose another image after a previous illustrated turn. Reminder intervals are reserved 3 / natural 1 / eager 1 turns, subject to the minimum reminder interval; this is not image frequency. Cooldown, recent deduplication and probability are independent. A positive inject_interval_n overrides the tier interval; 0 follows the tier.
